comments.author: billti
comments.story: Douglas Hofstadter changes his mind on Deep Learning and AI risk
comments.why: Logical case for AI risk that has aged well
comments.text: I don't think many people are worried that what we have now is a major risk. The major concern is the implications of the trajectory we are now on. If you look at what ChatGPT and Midjourney and the like can do now compared to just a couple of years ago, it's pretty incredible. If you extrapolate the next few similar jumps in capability, and assume that won't be 20 years away, then what AI is going to be capable of before even my kids leave college is going to be mind-boggling, and in some possible futures not in a good way. I remember seeing this talk from Sam Harris nearly 6 years ago and it logically making a lot of sense back then ( [VIDEO] ). The past couple of years have made this all the more prescient. (Worth a watch if you have 15 mins).
